info.name: Project API integration tests
info.description: End-to-end smoke tests replayed by newman in CI (MAIR-117). `baseUrl` is injected by docker-compose-integration.yml; the default in environment.json targets a local stack. JWTs are forged in the collection pre-request script with the stack's JWT_SECRET for the seeded Admin (user 1) and a plain agent (user 2, seeded by init-test.sql). The scenario creates a project, manages its members and tasks from both roles, then closes and deletes it, so it is replayable against a persistent database.
